body.name: Stopped-design estimators of envelope inputs
body.construction: For even \(n\ge N_0\), within each observed arm compute the centered outcome--covariate covariance \(\widehat c_{z,n}\) and the intercept-including OLS residual mean square \(\widehat S_{e_z,n}^2\), using the Moore--Penrose fit on singular samples. Set \(\widehat b_n=S_{xx,n}^{-1/2}(\widehat c_{1,n}+\widehat c_{0,n})\) and \(\widehat u_n=2\widehat S_{e_1,n}^2+2\widehat S_{e_0,n}^2\).
